title: Recycling at Home
text:
Recycling helps our planet. Many families now separate plastic, paper and glass before they throw them away. In some towns, there are special bins for each type of waste.

My neighbour, Anna, has a small compost box in her garden. She puts old fruit and vegetables into it. After a few months, the waste becomes rich soil for her flowers.

questions.text: What do many families separate before they throw them away?
What does Anna keep in her garden?
Why do some towns have special bins for each type of waste?
What can we infer about Anna?
options: She lives in the city centre

vocabulary.definition: to divide things into different groups
a mixture of old plants and food that helps plants grow
things that are no longer needed and are thrown away
the top layer of earth in which plants grow

paragraph_translations: Recykling pomaga naszej planecie. Wiele rodzin oddziela teraz plastik, papier i szkło, zanim je wyrzuci. W niektórych miastach są specjalne pojemniki na każdy rodzaj odpadów.
Moja sąsiadka, Anna, ma w ogrodzie małą skrzynkę na kompost. Wkłada do niej stare owoce i warzywa. Po kilku miesiącach odpady zmieniają się w żyzną glebę dla jej kwiatów.
